title: Choco Banana Canonical Representation
description: Rectangle grid where some cells carry positive integer clues. Players shade cells so every shaded (chocolate) group forms a rectangle and every unshaded (banana) group does not. A clue gives the size of the group (shaded or unshaded) its cell belongs to.

cells.description: m x n grid of integers. 0 = empty (no clue), positive integer = group-size clue.
